# Ouroboros: the agent harness where it all started

## Story
At sunrise on the wide timber deck of a clean modern beach house, a small agent stands at the deck's edge with its tool bag on its back, looking out over the dunes to the sea where its day's work begins, while its person watches fondly from the open glass door, and Ouro suns himself on the warm front step.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: the person's chest height, as if we stand on the deck a few steps in front of the house. The house wall, the glass door and the deck's front edge are seen square-on, running straight across the frame and parallel to the bottom of the picture. One vanishing point, at the centre of the picture on the sea's horizon, which is also the eye level for every object in the scene. Keep the scene simple: only the deck's two side edges and the sea's horizon recede.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides to an 8:3 strip, so the crop band is the whole height, and the cast sits close together across the middle half of the width and fills most of its height. Left to right: the open glass door with the person standing in it, Ouro on the front step just right of the door, the agent on the deck at the right, close to the deck's edge. Safe area: the left quarter is more of the house's pale cedar wall with a tall plain glass window and a potted olive tree; the right quarter is the open deck edge, soft dunes and the sea. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, standing in the open glass door of their home.
- Material: a matte frosted glass head and neck, like softly sandblasted glass, with a soft, even warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at the core and no glossy highlights; the head reads as one soft, opaque-looking frosted form with nothing visible inside it; a real adult head: a slightly elongated oval skull, a clear jaw line and a natural neck about four tenths of the head's width joining the shoulders; no ears (the sides of the head are smooth, with no ear shape or ear outline at all); no face at all: no eyes, nose, brow, mouth or smile; never a clear bubble or bulb, never milky white or saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the standing height or a little less, never larger, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the top of the head is well below the top of the tall glass door.
- Outfit: a long soft oatmeal knit cardigan coat with a wide open collar, so the whole neck shows between the jaw and the collar, over a white T-shirt, with two large, clearly drawn patch pockets at the hips; relaxed light-grey linen trousers and simple white slides.
- Expression: faceless; fond pride shown by the body: one shoulder leaning on the door's frame, head tilted toward the agent.
- Pose: standing on the threshold, leaning one shoulder on the door frame, both feet flat on the threshold and fully visible.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both hands are pushed deep into the two large hip pockets of the cardigan, so no hand and no skin shows: each sleeve ends with its knit cuff going straight into a clearly drawn dark pocket opening.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame toward the agent; head turned toward the agent.

### The agent
- What: a small robot agent about to set off for the day's work.
- Material: smooth, seamless sea-blue glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor and a tiny antenna with a blue bead.
- Height: the top of its head reaches the person's hip.
- Outfit: a sand-coloured canvas backpack on two wide straps, with a wrench handle and a rolled measuring tape poking out of its top, and a short coral knit scarf, its ends lifting a little toward the left in the sea breeze from the right.
- Expression: eager and ready: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes lifted toward the sea, held level; no mouth and no line, curve, reflection or highlight under the eyes; the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing on the deck close to its edge, both feet flat on the deck, weight even, body side-on to the camera and facing the sea at the right.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. The near arm reaches forward and its mitten rests flat on the wide flat top of a stout square timber post at the deck's edge; the far arm is hidden entirely behind its body and the backpack, so only one hand shows.
- Facing: body side-on to the camera, facing the sea at the right; head turned toward the camera a little so both eyes read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the person's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat and small: his whole coil is only about 15 percent of the person's height, about as tall as the agent's knee and clearly less than half the agent's height; a slim tube, not a thick one.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: content, eyes half-closed in the warm sun.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting flat on the wide pale concrete front step just outside the threshold, in a patch of sunlight, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the step.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the camera, turned a little toward the agent, eyes half-closed.

## Props
- Glass door: a tall frameless glass pivot door in a slim dark-bronze frame, swung open inward toward the left, its two hinge pivots clearly drawn at the top and bottom of its frame.
- Home: a clean, low modern beach house of pale cedar boards and smooth white render, a wide flat roof edge, a tall plain glass window to the left of the door with a potted olive tree in a white pot beside it, and a slim cylindrical matte-white wall light on a round backplate beside the door, unlit by day.
- Front step: one wide, smooth pale concrete step in front of the threshold, seen square-on.
- Deck: a wide, level deck of weathered pale timber boards running across the picture in front of the house, seen square-on, its boards parallel to the front edge, ending in a plain straight edge with the dunes beyond.
- Post: one stout square pale timber post with a flat square cap, rising to the agent's chest from the deck's edge at the right, drawn complete from the deck to its cap.
- Backpack: sand-coloured canvas, on the agent, with its two straps clearly drawn over the shoulders.

## Setting
A modern beach house on the coastal dunes at sunrise: a clear horizon with a calm, bright sea, soft pale sand dunes with silvery marram grass beyond the deck's edge, a pale beach and a low headland on the far right, a clear sky of soft blue and pale peach. A light sea breeze from the right lifts the agent's scarf toward the left. Keep the dunes simple and soft.

## Light
This is a bright, clear early-morning DAY picture, never night, dusk or twilight: the whole sky is bright daylight blue with a soft pale peach glow near the horizon, and there is no moon. Low, clear sunrise from the right with the sun itself out of frame beyond the right edge: a gentle warm key light on every figure's right side and soft, even daylight elsewhere. Shadows are few and soft-edged: a soft contact shadow under the person's feet, the agent's feet, the post and Ouro; no sunbeams, no light shafts, no stripes or bands of sunlight on the deck or walls; the deck and walls are evenly lit. The bright sky fills the scene with clean, luminous daylight. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head.

## Palette
Clear soft blue and pale peach sky, bright sea blue, pale sand, silvery dune green, pale cedar and white render, oatmeal and light grey; emerald for Ouro; sea blue and coral for the agent. No amber, no dark wood, no stone cottage.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing, no waving, no thumbs-up.
- No hand of the person showing: both stay in the pockets; no skin at the pockets.
- No second hand on the agent: its far arm stays hidden behind its body.
- No rope rail, no railing and no boardwalk receding into the distance.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint, milky or coloured-balloon person; no face and no ears on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No glowing trails, motion lines or lines of light.
- No phones, laptops, monitors or screens.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic, cottage, hobbit-hole or storybook house: no round door, no stone doorway, no thatch, no dark wood, no amber light.
- No moon, no stars, no night and no dusk; no sun in the frame, no sunbeams, no lens flare.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No giant Ouro: he is never taller than the agent's knee.
